sections.heading: Chiranjeevi — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: Chiranjeevi was born on 22 August 1955 in Mogalthur, and holds Indian nationality. He was given the name Konidela Sivasankara Varaprasad at birth and is publicly known as Chiranjeevi.
Public records name his father, Venkat Rao Konidela and his mother, Anjana Devi Konidela. He is a sibling of Pawan Kalyan and Nagendra Babu.
His listed education includes Adyar Film Institute.
He is recorded as speaking Telugu and English.

sections.heading: Chiranjeevi — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician, film producer and film actor as his occupations.
He has held the following offices: Minister of Tourism (2012–2014). He is affiliated with Indian National Congress.
